We propose AdMIRaL (Autoregressive document Multi-hop Information Retrieval with Natural Logic-guidance), a novel multi-hop document retriever for RnR that consists of two components: i) a retriever that jointly scores documents in the KB and sentences reranked from previously retrieved documents using an autoregressive formulation, ii) a proof system using Natural Logic to assess the sufficiency of the evidence retrieved to verify a given claim, and terminate the retrieval of further documents.
